prospects.ask: Can a paid 2,900 EUR third-party evidence-chain audit be commissioned as a small Trust Lab research pilot or bought by a client of yours?
prospects.message:
Hello Just Verify Trust Lab,

I develop ASTRA ProofLab Ω, an independent, fail-closed evidence-auditing workflow for AI research and software claims. It links exact claims to immutable source code, SHA-256 artifacts, CI run receipts and bounded Lean theorem checks where applicable, and preserves negative-control failures.

Your Trust Lab research on evidence, provenance and accountable verification is highly relevant. Could we explore one FIXED-SCOPE paid pilot or a subcontracted client evidence pack? The proposed scope is one mutually agreed public repository/commit, up to five claims, a JSON audit ledger, negative controls and a concise reproducibility report for a proposed EUR 2,900 before applicable tax, subject to written contracting terms.

Working demonstrator: https://astra-prooflab-6jyfg1.v2.appdeploy.ai/
Technical case study: https://github.com/Dr-starck66/DeepReasoning-Architecture-/blob/astra/prooflab-commercial-20261101/research/eth_repro/commercial/BUYER_CASE_STUDY_2026-11-01.md

Could you direct this to the commercial/research manager for fixed-fee evidence audits? I do not claim safety certification or proof of an arbitrary general scientific theorem.

Regards,
Dr Starck
